exact_statement: For the actual Boolean sign f=-1+2z+2xy-2z[ax+(1-a)y] at interior product probabilities (alpha,e,d,q), let Delta=I-Var, T be the total triple Fourier mass, E the natural corrected nonempty entropy, S=4Delta-2T-E_single, and G=E_ge2-ln(4)Delta. For 0<d<=e<1, G/T<=2sqrt(q)+2sqrt(alpha)+2d/[e(1-e)]+2sqrt(e)/(1-e). Thus whenever 0<alpha,q,e<=1/16 and 0<d<=e/16, G<=5T/3 and (4+ln4)Delta-E>=S+T/3>=T/3. The swapped collar alpha->1-alpha, e<->d also satisfies this. Every nonnegative polynomial reserve S_m from the retained-slack hierarchy satisfies S_m+2T-G>=T/3 on those collars. In particular the old all-fixed-order obstruction path (t,t^2,t^4,t), 0<t<=1/16, is paid directly. This is a collar theorem only; at fair biases G/T=4ln2>2, so reserve-free G<=2T is not universal.
